faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Civify

q1.question: Is my data private?
q1.answer: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption and never share your personal information with third parties. Your CV data is stored securely and you can delete it anytime.

q2.question: What makes a CV ATS-friendly?
q2.answer: ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) scan CVs for specific keywords, proper formatting, and standard section headers. Our templates are designed to pass ATS scans while still looking professional to human recruiters.

q3.question: Can I customize the CV manually?
q3.answer: Yes! After AI optimization, you have full control to edit any section, adjust formatting, and customize the content to match your personal style.

q4.question: Do you save my documents?
q4.answer: Your CVs are saved securely in your account so you can access and edit them anytime. You can also download them locally and delete them from our servers whenever you want.

q5.question: How accurate is the match score?
q5.answer: Our match score is based on industry-standard ATS algorithms and keyword analysis. While no score is 100% predictive, our users report significantly higher interview rates with scores above 80%.
